integrity: Exact exhaustive 32768-case computation using two differently implemented GF(2) span and product recurrences; explicit code, table, witness masks, digest, and full proof of search exhaustiveness are provided. Scientific literature priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Complete labelled triangular binary 6x6 matrix census and corresponding F2 nilpotent-algebra index spectrum only. Matrix counts are not isomorphism-class counts. The infinite-field spectrum conjecture and upper exclusions over larger characteristic-two fields are not proved.
title: The complete binary six-dimensional nilpotency-index census for evolution algebras
